The '''Socorro Freight building''' was a building maintained by the shipping company [[Socorro Freight]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]]' [[Artisan Arrivals Court]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Republic forces under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rikdine]] set up a command base in the building.
